sources.rationale: Reuse core eight-field role-aware domain fingerprint; donor six-field format cannot replace it.
Strict finite/dimension validation reused through core Vector. New float32 byte receipt matches pgvector persistence; cosine ranking is not imported.
Adapt exact immutable candidate resolution, pre/post provider space checks and typed failure preservation. Core owns final disclosure.
Adapt equal-dimension space mutation, rebuilt-handle, malicious candidate and immutable historical identity regression patterns.
Adapt explicit model-revision pinning. Reject legacy unbound/default fallback and omit credentials/base URLs from identity.
Adapt acceptance of precomputed vectors after strict validation. No LlamaIndex/FAISS dependency or recanonicalization during vector rebuild.
Adapt authorized corpus isolation before nearest-neighbor retrieval. SQL materialization supplies exact and temporary HNSW corpora, with measured recall and explicit fallback.
Adapt interrupted staging, exact source/signature checks and old-published-pointer preservation to transactional PostgreSQL publication.

localReuse: Core canonical chunksets, ResourceInventory, catalog locks, staging and atomic snapshot Publisher/Activation; no parallel publication protocol.
Existing synthetic lexical/document fixtures reused read-only; vector expectations independently authored.
sourceGaps: Donors do not provide PostgreSQL generation membership, float32 receipts, tenant-qualified prefilter SQL or measured authorized HNSW recall; these pieces are new code against the approved ports.
ANN creates a temporary HNSW corpus per query and compares exact top-k; correctness baseline, not a production throughput claim.
No optional external provider implementation is claimed by host callback contract tests.
